comments.author: vaxman
comments.story: The year is 1993, The Amiga is everything for me
comments.text: I mean, some people show up to the blow out party three years after it ended, sure. That they're still talking about it 33 years later gives you an indication of what the main event must have been like [VIDEO] [LINK]

comments.author: trembolram
comments.why: Amiga launch event with famous demos like bouncing ball
comments.text: The Mandrill was part of the launch event of Amiga in 1985 at the Lincoln Center. The event also included other famous demos, such as the bouncing ball. [VIDEO]

comments.author: virgulino
comments.story: Andy Warhol's lost Amiga art found
comments.why: Warhol painting Debbie Harry at the 1985 Amiga launch
comments.text: "The World Premiere of the Amiga (1985, Andy Warhol, Debbie Harry): Possibly wanting to one-up the Apple Macintosh launch in 1984, the Amiga 1000 debuted at a black-tie event held at the Vivian Beaumont Theater at Lincoln Center in New York City on July 23rd, 1985.
